hero.title: Give a few hours. Change what someone thinks is possible.
hero.body: You don't need to be sent by a company, and there's no minimum commitment. Answer a few messages a term, meet a student for a chat, or give one talk at a school. You decide how far it goes.

quote.body: Some of the people I met in my first job knew exactly what they needed to do. They had already laid the groundwork with law firm trainee contracts waiting for them; these sons and daughters of solicitors knew exactly what to do to get a traineeship at a big firm (and it probably helped that they knew a few people inside those firms too). I had supportive parents, but in this job market it isn't only about wanting it. It helps to know someone who'll give you that first chance. Social Capital is for people who don't have the same phonebook.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.body: Takes about two minutes. We'll follow up before you're listed anywhere, so there's no risk of being contacted before you're ready.
